meta.summary: Xiph Directory: hide the logo intro and genre tags, blur or hide now-playing text and station descriptions
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: dir.xiph.org home page in headless Chrome (desktop UA); the markup is the same Bootstrap 4 page on a phone, so desktop-real.html is a copy of real.html. The directory is a plain static page with no cookie banner, ads, pop-ups or app prompt, so the three original generic options match nothing here and no annoyance option was added; they are kept unchanged. Counts on the home page: `main > h1` 1, `main > p.lead` 1, `.card-footer a.badge` 88 (30 cards), `.card-subtitle` 30, `.card-text` 30. Fixtures are structural captures with station text stripped and `data-keep` on the nav brand, search box, cards, titles and Play buttons.

The recipe also matches www.xiph.org (the Xiph project site), which was not checked. NOT verified: /genres, /codecs and /search result pages (the network failed during the later re-check).
